downside.definition: sqrt(sum(min(one-minute log return,0)^2)) over all 30 returns; zero target, not mean-centered or negative-count normalized
downside.aggregation: Asset MAE within original scored_assets, then equal-weight events; same event/asset sets for all four methods. Top3 uniform cutoff-tie expected recall.

aggregate.interpretation: 无方向预测能力（本样本未证实），不进 pitch
aggregate.aggregation: Pooled asset-event pairs; correlated within/across events, not independent sample count.

radius.definition: Contiguous prefix from minute 0 with strictly smaller equal-event-weight mean MAE than frozen historical_30. Later isolated wins do not extend radius.
radius.boundary_policy: Each predicted segment uses its own path C0/C10/C20; actual uses its own. Peak resets per segment; population log-return std times sqrt(10).
radius.disclosure: Exploratory descriptive definition, not guaranteed future warning capability; events may overlap and are not independent.

definitions.systemic: Original posthoc true/false label; false can include simultaneous origins.
definitions.scoring: Tier intersects original scored_assets; other cuts retain that whole original universe.
definitions.aggregation: Within-event asset MAE then equal-weight events; four methods use identical sets.
definitions.top3: Original uniform cutoff-tie expected recall; k remains 3. N<3 is null, never smaller k.
definitions.chance: Mean 3/N among Top3-defined events; not a simulated baseline or full-set accuracy.
definitions.overlap: Axes overlap; their event counts are not additional independent observations.
definitions.empty: Empty groups and empty event-tier intersections are visible; estimates are null, not zero.
